leadText:
Pocket Monsters Premier 10 (Japanese: アニメ「ポケットモンスター」プレミア１０ Anime "Pocket Monsters" Premier 10) was a series of reruns of ten select episodes from past series of to commemorate its 20th anniversary following the theatrical release of M20. It aired on TV Tokyo every Monday at 1:35 AM from July 24 to September 25, 2017. 

For the series' first episode, a digitally remastered version of EP001 was broadcast on television for the first time.
